run_compare_namespaces: run the script to interactively compare two argparse.Namespace objects and show differences
review_main: review the main function that evaluates two Namespace inputs and compares their keys and values
summarize_keys: summarize the keys helper function that extracts non-private attributes from a Namespace object
summarize_print_keys: summarize the print_keys helper that prints key-value pairs from one or two Namespace objects
test_compare_namespaces: test the script by providing two Namespace objects and verifying unique and differing keys are reported
